map.0.1mm、样本 30 件。公差 T = 10.5−9.5 = 1.0mm；CP: standard deviation of 0.1 mm and a sample of 30 pieces. Tolerance T = 10.5 − 9.5 = 1.0 mm; CP = 1.0 ÷ (6 × 0.1) = 1.67; CPU = (10.5 − 10.0) ÷ (3 × 0.1) = 1.67, CPL = (10.0 − 9.5) ÷ 0.3 = 1.67, CPK = min = 1.67; the tolerance centre is 10.0 mm and CA = |10.0 − 10.0| ÷ (1.0 ÷ 2) = 0% (centred, no offset); if a long-term/overall standard deviation of 0.12 mm is entered (20% larger than the short-term σ), PPK = 1.0 ÷ (6 × 0.12) = 1.389; without a long-term σ the page does not compute PPK (no short-term approximation). Conclusion: CPK ≥ 1.33 means the capability is acceptable and the centring is good.
map.过程能力指数 CP/CPK/PPK 与良率: Process capability indices CP/CPK/PPK and yield
map.CP（潜在能力）= T ÷ (6 × 组内标准差 σ): CP (potential capability) = T ÷ (6 × within-subgroup standard deviation σ)
map.CA 偏移系数 = |μ − M| ÷ (T/2)，M = (USL + LSL: CA offset coefficient = |μ − M| ÷ (T/2), M = (USL + LSL) ÷ 2
map.PPK（长期能力）= T ÷ (6 × σ_总体)，σ_总体 为选填的长期/总体: PPK (long-term capability) = T ÷ (6 × σ_overall), where σ_overall is the optional long-term/overall standard deviation; when left blank PPK shows "not calculated" and no short-term σ approximation is used
map.CPK 判定：≥1.67 过剩｜≥1.33 合格｜≥1.00 临界｜≥0.67: CPK grading: ≥1.67 excess | ≥1.33 acceptable | ≥1.00 marginal | ≥0.67 insufficient | otherwise severely insufficient
map.约束：σ > 0、USL > LSL，长期 σ 若填写须 > 0: Constraints: σ > 0, USL > LSL, and any long-term σ entered must be > 0
map.长期标准差须大于 0（留空则不计算 PPK）: The long-term standard deviation must be greater than 0 (leave blank to skip PPK)
map.未计算（未填长期标准差）: Not calculated (no long-term standard deviation entered)
map.样本数 n<30，长期能力估计参考性有限: Sample size n < 30, so the long-term capability estimate is of limited reliability
map.CPK 和 CP 有什么不同？: What is the difference between CPK and CP?
map.CP 只看公差宽度与过程离散度（潜力），不考虑均值偏移；CPK = min(CP: CP only looks at tolerance width and process spread (the potential) and ignores mean offset; CPK = min(CPU, CPL) also accounts for offset and better reflects actual capability. When the mean is centred CPK = CP, and the larger the offset the smaller the CPK.
map.CPK 达到多少算合格？: What value of CPK counts as acceptable?
map.一般工业：CPK≥1.33 合格（推荐），≥1.67 能力过剩可放宽公差，1.0: In general industry: CPK ≥ 1.33 is acceptable (recommended), ≥ 1.67 means excess capability so the tolerance can be relaxed, 1.0 to 1.33 is marginal and needs improvement, and below 1.0 is insufficient. Industries such as automotive often require ≥ 1.33 or even ≥ 1.67.
